headline: Mozambique and Russia Agree to Expand Bilateral Commercial Cooperation
summary: The governments of Mozambique and Russia formally expressed commitments to deepen bilateral diplomatic relations and increase economic and commercial trade between both nations.
why: Mozambique holds immense offshore natural gas fields and strategic mineral deposits, making its geopolitical trade alignments relevant for international resource markets.

impacts.name: Mozambique
impacts.why: Closer economic ties open potential trade corridors but risk diplomatic friction with Western financing partners.
